ic_name: AMBA AXI4-Stream Protocol (ARM IHI 0051, Single Unidirectional Stream Channel)

bring_up_sequence.description: The master asserts TVALID when it has valid payload (TDATA / TSTRB / TKEEP /

test_cases_present: partial - the AMBA AXI4-Stream specification defines interface timing and compliance behaviors (handshake, byte types, packet framing, routing) rather than a packaged testbench; AXI4-Stream BFMs / VIP and protocol checkers exercise them.
derived_compliance_test_categories: TVALID/TREADY handshake: transfer only when both HIGH on a rising ACLK edge.
TVALID held until TREADY HIGH; payload stable while TVALID HIGH and TREADY LOW.
Master does NOT wait for TREADY before asserting TVALID.
Slave waits for TVALID before asserting TREADY (and may assert TREADY first).
Backpressure: slave deasserts TREADY; master stalls; no data lost.
Byte types: data (TKEEP=1,TSTRB=1), position (TKEEP=1,TSTRB=0), null (TKEEP=0,TSTRB=0); illegal TKEEP=0,TSTRB=1 never driven.
Packet framing: TLAST on the last transfer; correct packet lengths.
Routing: TDEST selects destination; TID preserves per-stream order.
TUSER sideband carried correctly (per transfer or per byte lane).
Reset: TVALID LOW while ARESETn LOW; first TVALID only after ARESETn HIGH.
TVALID/TREADY-only interface (no TDATA) used purely for TID/TDEST or transfer counting.
